description: Deterministic scripted bot (successor to Ironclad): rallies newly trained units near home instead of trickling them out alone, only committing to an attack once a real strike force has formed or the game clock forces the issue. Fixes an under-reaction bug in the original's emergency worker-defense (it capped the response at half the workforce, which lost to swarms bigger than that), rebalances Light/Heavy/Ranged production, and recognizes single-unit-economy rush opponents (HeavyRush/LightRush/WorkerRush) to respond appropriately.
